items.title: 阿联酋与莫桑比克完成CEPA谈判，双边非石油贸易约26亿美元
items.title_en: UAE and Mozambique conclude CEPA negotiations as bilateral non-oil trade reaches US$2.6bn
items.category: CEPA谈判完成／尚待签署生效
items.summary: 阿联酋和莫桑比克于2026年11月14日宣布完成全面经济伙伴关系协定（CEPA）谈判。双方2025年非石油贸易约26亿美元，2026年前九个月约25亿美元。协议仍须签署、批准并生效，关税优惠及市场准入承诺届时才能实施；该消息并非贸易协定已经生效。
items.summary_en: On 14 November 2026, the UAE and Mozambique announced the conclusion of negotiations for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA). Bilateral non-oil trade reached approximately US$2.6 billion in 2025 and US$2.5 billion in the first nine months of 2026. The agreement must still be signed, ratified and brought into force before tariff benefits and market-access commitments apply; it is not yet in effect.
items.why_it_matters: 未来可能改善两国货物和服务贸易、物流及投资环境，但企业暂不能把拟议优惠当作现行政策。
items.why_it_matters_en: The prospective agreement may improve trade, logistics and investment conditions, but companies cannot yet rely on its proposed preferential terms.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注中国品牌经阿联酋出口东非、贸易代理、物流与市场进入服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Explore Chinese brands' exports through the UAE into East Africa, trading agencies, logistics and market-entry services.
items.stage: 谈判完成／待签署及生效

items.title: Asyad启用阿曼杜库姆港至阿联酋Khalifa Port绿色物流通道
items.title_en: Asyad opens Duqm–Khalifa Port green trade corridor linking Oman and the UAE
items.sector: 港口物流及跨境供应链
items.summary: Asyad Group于11月14日公布杜库姆港至阿布扎比Khalifa Port绿色贸易通道正式运营，已通过杜库姆Asyad集装箱码头实现每周货运。货物由杜库姆港经阿曼与阿联酋边境陆路口岸及Al Ain Dry Port运抵Khalifa Port，再衔接海湾分销网络，结合集装箱处理、公路运输与跨境海关协调。
items.summary_en: On 14 November, Asyad Group announced operations of its Duqm–Khalifa Port Green Corridor, with regular weekly cargo movements through Asyad Container Terminal at the Port of Duqm. Cargo is transferred by road through the Oman–UAE border and Al Ain Dry Port to Khalifa Port in Abu Dhabi, combining port handling, trucking and coordinated customs arrangements with GCC distribution networks.
items.why_it_matters: 连接两个海湾物流节点，可形成海陆联运及跨境货物分拨业务，通道为在运营的运输服务而非新码头工程。
items.why_it_matters_en: The operating corridor strengthens sea-road cargo links and creates potential distribution opportunities; it is a transport service, not a newly awarded port construction project.
items.gci_opportunity: 研究阿曼与阿联酋双向物流、集装箱运输、仓储、清关和中国供应商中转合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Explore Oman–UAE bilateral logistics, containers, warehousing, customs clearance and Chinese suppliers' transshipment needs.

items.title: 阿曼穆桑代姆规划2,000万美元Khasab综合农业城
items.title_en: Oman plans US$20 million Khasab Agricultural City in Musandam
items.summary: 11月14日报道，Musandam Global Investment Company与Yulin Holding拟在阿曼穆桑代姆省Khasab的Sal Asfal发展Khasab Agricultural City，规划用地约46.2万平方米，投资计划约2,000万美元。项目包括温室、灌溉、农业生产、苗圃、植物组织培养及物流配套，相关土地使用权协议于Food Security Lab 2026期间签署。尚未公布独立建设总包。
items.summary_en: Reported on 14 November, Musandam Global Investment Company and Yulin Holding plan a US$20 million Khasab Agricultural City on approximately 462,000 square metres in Sal Asfal, Khasab, Musandam. Proposed facilities include greenhouses, irrigation, agricultural production, nurseries, plant tissue culture and logistics support. A usufruct agreement was signed during Food Security Lab 2026; no construction EPC award was announced.
items.why_it_matters: 投资主体及地块较明确，可提前接触农业设施与技术供应链，但仍需核实设备采购时间。
items.why_it_matters_en: The identified partners and site offer an early lead for agricultural infrastructure and technology supply, subject to procurement timing.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注温室、灌溉、农业机械、冷链、农业建筑及中国技术合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track greenhouses, irrigation, agricultural machinery, cold chains, farm buildings and Chinese technology partners.
items.stage: 土地协议已签／农业城规划

items.title: 阿曼在日内瓦推介2亿美元风机制造项目与低碳钢产业机会
items.title_en: Oman showcases US$200m wind turbine manufacturing project and low-carbon steel opportunities
items.sector: 新能源制造与绿色工业
items.summary: 阿曼OPAZ于11月14日在日内瓦世界投资会议推介新能源制造、低碳钢和其他工业投资机会。其中包括在杜库姆与上海电气风电合作开发的风机制造厂，投资计划约2亿美元、目标年产约100台风机，并涉及工业人才培训。该厂是既有项目，本次为国际招商推介，并非11月14日新签投资合同。
items.summary_en: On 14 November, Oman's OPAZ presented renewable equipment manufacturing, low-carbon steel and other industrial opportunities in Geneva. It highlighted an existing proposed wind turbine manufacturing factory in Duqm involving Shanghai Electric Wind Power Group, with an investment value of about US$200 million and target capacity of 100 turbines annually, alongside workforce training. This was an investment promotion update, not a new contract signed that day.
items.why_it_matters: 既有风电制造投资可形成产业配套与中国企业本地化合作；新闻价值主要在对外招商进展。
items.why_it_matters_en: The previously announced turbine manufacturing initiative may support local supply-chain opportunities and Chinese industrial partnerships; the current development is investment promotion.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进风机制造供应链、工业设备、低碳钢、厂房配套和本地化制造合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track wind-turbine manufacturing supplies, industrial equipment, low-carbon steel, facilities and localisation.
items.stage: 投资推介／项目非当日新签

items.title: 布基纳法索发布71.3公里Banfora至科特迪瓦边境道路工程国际招标
items.title_en: Burkina Faso issues international tender for 71.3 km Banfora–Côte d'Ivoire border road works
items.category: 公开国际工程招标／两标段
items.summary: 布基纳法索于11月13日发布Banfora至科特迪瓦边境71.3公里道路修复及加固国际公开招标，PIRCoFaT项目获得非洲开发基金贷款及欧盟赠款支持。第一标段Banfora—Koutoura约35.3公里，第二标段Koutoura—边境约36公里，涵盖道路土方、路面、排水与安全配套。具体报名与交标要求应查看官方招标文件。
items.summary_en: On 13 November, Burkina Faso published an open international tender for rehabilitation and strengthening of 71.3 km of road between Banfora and the Côte d'Ivoire border under the AfDB/ADF- and EU-supported PIRCoFaT programme. Lot 1 is approximately 35.3 km from Banfora to Koutoura; Lot 2 covers 36.0 km from Koutoura to the border. Works include earthworks, pavement, drainage and road safety. Eligibility and submission requirements must be checked in the tender documents.
items.why_it_matters: 该项目是真实开放的道路施工标段，但需评估当地执行、资格及风险后才具备参与条件。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a genuine open road-works procurement, subject to bidder qualification, local execution arrangements and risk assessment.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注道路工程承包商、工程机械、沥青、钢材及项目配套供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor road contractors, construction machinery, asphalt, steel and ancillary project supplies.
items.source_name: African Development Bank / SP-PST Burkina Faso

items.title: 沙迦SPC自贸区与Wio Bank合作简化企业银行开户
items.title_en: Sharjah SPC Free Zone and Wio Bank partner to simplify business bank account applications
items.summary: 沙迦出版城自贸区SPC Free Zone于11月14日与Wio Bank签署合作备忘录，为自贸区注册企业提供数字银行业务介绍及银行账户申请引导。银行会联系企业并依据自身准入和合规程序审核开户申请，合作不代表申请必获批准。
items.summary_en: On 14 November, Sharjah Publishing City Free Zone signed an MoU with Wio Bank to facilitate access to digital business banking services for companies registered in the free zone. SPC will introduce and refer interested companies, while Wio Bank will assess each account application under its own eligibility and compliance rules. Approval is not guaranteed.
items.why_it_matters: 本地企业设立与银行服务衔接便利化，对中小企业经营和商务落地具有实际参考意义。
items.why_it_matters_en: Simpler banking referrals may support business setup and SME operations, subject to bank approval.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注阿联酋新设企业开户、商务运营支持及企业服务合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Explore UAE company account-opening guidance, operational support and business-services partnerships.
items.stage: MoU签署／开户仍需银行审核

items.title: 阿曼前8个月港口船舶挂靠量突破1.1万艘
items.title_en: Oman's ports record over 11,000 vessel calls in January–August 2026
items.category: 阶段性行业数据／11月14日再报道
items.summary: 阿曼11月14日报道2026年1月至8月的港口经营指标：挂靠船舶超过11,000艘，同比增长27.9%；集装箱吞吐量超过400万TEU，同比增长20.5%；货物吞吐量约1.46亿吨，同比增长62.3%。这些是截至8月底的历史累计数据，阿曼主管部门此前已于10月18日公布，11月14日由媒体再次报道，不是11月新增吞吐量。
items.summary_en: On 14 November, Omani media revisited port statistics for January through August 2026: more than 11,000 vessel calls, up 27.9% year on year; container throughput exceeding 4 million TEU, up 20.5%; and cargo volume of about 146 million tonnes, up 62.3%. These are historical cumulative figures to August, first released by the ministry on 18 October and reported again in November, not newly generated volumes in November.
items.why_it_matters: 数据反映阿曼物流市场增长趋势，适合用于商业趋势分析而非声称新合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: The figures describe Oman's expanding logistics market, not a newly awarded project or contract.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注阿曼港口物流、货代、仓储、供应链分拨与中国进出口企业合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor port logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing, distribution and Chinese import-export partnerships.

items.title: 迪拜商会举办Quality Performance Lab推动企业质量和运营效率
items.title_en: Dubai Chambers holds Quality Performance Lab to improve business performance and operational efficiency
items.summary: 迪拜商会于11月14日与英国特许质量协会CQI阿联酋网络合作举办Quality Performance Lab，约70名企业及专业人士参加，围绕质量管理、运营效率、客户体验及绩效改进开展实践交流。活动属于企业管理能力建设新闻，并非工程投资或采购公告。
items.summary_en: On 14 November, Dubai Chambers organised a Quality Performance Lab with the Chartered Quality Institute (CQI) UAE Network, attended by around 70 business representatives and quality, operations, customer experience and performance professionals. The event focused on practical approaches to quality management and operational efficiency. This is a business capability initiative, not a construction or procurement announcement.
items.why_it_matters: 企业效率、质量与客户体验成为本地商业服务议题，适合GCI企业运营支持业务关注。
items.why_it_matters_en: Quality, efficiency and customer experience are pertinent issues for UAE SME support and business operations services.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注企业流程改善、管理系统、效率提升及本地企业服务客户开发。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Explore operational improvement, management systems, efficiency programmes and UAE business-services client development.
